title: Linked carved turns
subtitle: Seen from the front, and what your boots will show
steps: Roll both ankles and knees into each turn and let the skis carve a clean arc.
Keep a steady rhythm and avoid skidding the tails.

callouts.text: Each hump is one turn: tilt builds, peaks, then eases off.
Crossing the middle line is the switch of edges. Quick and tidy.
Both boots tilt together: the skis work as a pair.

footnote: Illustration of a typical shape, not a target. Tilt is relative, not degrees.
